nodes.summary: Convergence tests (root test, rearrangement theorem, Stolz–Cesàro), normal and uniform convergence of series of functions, and specific limits of sequences and partial sums.
nodes.title: Convergence of sequences and series
Multisection of series by index factorization

nodes.summary: Identities and transformations of power series and exponential-type series: Lagrange inversion and the tree function, Abel- and Jensen-type exponential series, coefficients of exp of a power series and Newton's identities for summable sequences, transformations of factorial series and Taylor-shift transformations, and Touchard / generalized Bell series.
nodes.title: Power series and series transformations

nodes.summary: Series and infinite products evaluating constants: π, Catalan's constant, Euler's constant, √2, ζ(3), reciprocal central binomial sums.
nodes.title: Series for π, ζ(3) and other constants
Series of the form Σ rᵏ/(1 − a xᵏ)

nodes.summary: Matrix summability methods (Silverman–Toeplitz, Cesàro means, permanent methods) and Tauberian theorems of Tauber, Hardy–Littlewood, Wiener and Newman.
nodes.title: Summability and Tauberian theorems

nodes.summary: Closed forms for series in powers of sin, cos or tan, central binomial series in trigonometric arguments, partial-fraction series of trigonometric functions, and identities with harmonic or odd harmonic numbers, as in Ramanujan's notebooks Chapter 9.
nodes.title: Trigonometric and harmonic-number series

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
